agent_explanation: Controller destabilizes due to interaction of large dt=0.01987 (low control rate) with seeded sensor noise 0.0081 at initial theta=0.1 limit. Noisy theta measurement causes overcorrection, pumping mechanical energy from 1.47 to 9.63 and accelerating pole fall: theta 0.05@5 -> -0.15@10 -> -0.59@15 -> -0.81@17 with omega -5.7 rad/s and cart v 3.88. Removing noise stabilizes same scenario.
